data_description.scan_interval_hours: Reviews are published weekly at most; 6 hours is ample.
data_description.top_count: Kept small on purpose: attributes are recorded and sent to every client on each update.
data_description.history_count: How many past releases to retain, so a dashboard can show several weeks at once. Categories publish on different cadences: three releases is about three weeks of Tillfälligt sortiment, but roughly three months of Fast sortiment.
data_description.kinds: Webbviner are sold by independent merchants and have no Systembolaget article number.

confirm.title: Entity IDs do not match the example dashboard
confirm.description:
These Munskänkarna entities exist and hold data, but under IDs the example dashboard does not reference, so its cards report them as unknown:

{entities}

They were not renamed automatically because Home Assistant cannot be shown to have generated these IDs — you may have chosen them. Submit to rename them to the IDs after the arrows. Anything marked (taken) is skipped: another entity already holds that ID.

If you chose these IDs on purpose, close this instead and point the dashboard at the IDs you have.
